claims.statement: Every typed summary.advance outcome consumes one summary-lag unit and every typed snapshot.render outcome consumes one snapshot-work unit.

Conditional on the declared engineering bad-event budgets, one typed preview-to-commit vote path has a union-bound success budget of at least 98%; the retained observations are consistency checks and do not statistically establish the leaf budgets.
assumptions: A preview invocation has bad-event probability at most 1% and a commit invocation has bad-event probability at most 1% for the represented workload; these are engineering assumptions, not statistically inferred guarantees.

metadata.purpose: Mandatory plain-English promises for the certified vote reference application.
